cards.name: Biting Circle
cards.text: Mark a Stress to burn a circle into the floor around you. A foe that crosses into it takes 2d12+4 magic damage and is thrown back to Very Close.

cards.name: Echo Mark
cards.text: Spend 2 Light to mark an ally within Close, one at a time. The next blow they land also reaches the nearest other foe the same roll would beat.

cards.name: Echoing Swing
cards.text: The blow that spends the mark carries on to the next foe along.

abilities.name: Biting Circle
abilities.text: Mark a Stress to burn a circle into the floor around your own feet.

effects.text: A circle burns itself into the floor around their feet.

abilities.name: Echo Mark
abilities.text: Spend two Light to set an echo beside an ally close by, until their next blow lands.

effects.text: The air beside them doubles, and waits.

abilities.name: Echoing Swing
abilities.text: The blow that spends the mark also reaches the next foe along its roll would beat.

conditionDefs.name: Biting Circle
conditionDefs.text: Ground that answers anybody who steps onto it: 2d12+4 magic damage, and thrown back.

effects.text: The floor bites them as they cross it.

conditionDefs.name: Echoing
conditionDefs.text: The next blow you land also reaches the nearest other foe the same roll would beat.
